name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 5 visits over 26 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 25 hours starting 2025-06-02, at wavelengths from 1.17 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
